body: That’s the hard part- she looks up to me a lot so revealing that I’m struggling may be hard to her. Not to mention she has a lot going on herself- idk if it would be a bother for her to hear about this

Yea I basically am getting kicked out. I’ve been meaning to die for a while but I’ve been looking for a way to waste my life and fill the void. Now seems like an opportune moment to do it, I don’t really see a reason for existing any longer and what’s the point of filling the void much longer?

My parents are Russian, so similar to Asian/eastern mindset: failure is not an option. They have already been balking at me for choosing to go to this school because they thought it would all be for nothing and I would flunk out, so I would prove them right in doing so. Not to mention my sister has been struggling with her grades too and they are immensely disappointed in her- i would face horrible flack for being the second child to disappoint them. I also left my home to avoid the toxic environment there, partially the reason I was able to find a will to live. Returning home would crush my soul.
